name: Damian Chabracki
role: Full-Stack Software Engineer | TypeScript, Node.js, Python, C#

domains.title: Critical Infrastructure
domains.text: At Proffico: **security by design** for **SCADA/HMI**-class telemetry and field apps for water infrastructure, built to **NIS2** standards: contract-first APIs with strict runtime validation, code reviews, unit tests, **WCAG** accessibility and performance tuning for large real-time data volumes.
domains.blurb: Secure telemetry and field apps for water infrastructure to **NIS2**: contract-first APIs and strict validation.

domains.title: B2B & SaaS Products
domains.text: **Multi-tenancy by design:** a B2B platform and logistics marketplace in one `Turborepo` monorepo, built as a **modular monolith** with clean boundaries, client portal, admin panel, invoicing and Kanban automation, plus SEO-ready websites for SME clients.
domains.blurb: Multi-tenant B2B platform and logistics marketplace in one `Turborepo` monorepo: portal, admin panel, invoicing.

domains.title: Frontend, Desktop & Mobile
domains.text: `React`, `Next.js` (hybrid **SSR / SSG**) and strict `TypeScript` with `Tailwind CSS`, **accessibility-first** (`WCAG 2.2 AA`). State with `TanStack Query`; desktop in `Electron`, field apps in `React Native`, real-time charts in `ECharts`, maps in `Mapbox GL`.
domains.blurb: `React` and `Next.js` (SSR/SSG) in strict **TypeScript**, accessible (WCAG 2.2 AA); desktop in `Electron`, mobile in React Native.

domains.title: Backend & Data Layer
domains.text: **API-first** backends with `NestJS` and `Node.js`: **state-machine-driven** workflows, a **double-entry ledger**, relational `SQL` (`PostgreSQL`) and `MongoDB` modeling via `Prisma`, `OpenAPI` contracts, `RBAC` enforced in the API layer and rate-limited public APIs.
domains.blurb: API-first **NestJS** backends: state machines, double-entry ledger, `PostgreSQL` and `MongoDB` via `Prisma`, `OpenAPI`.

domains.title: Cloud & DevOps
domains.text: **Shift-left delivery:** `GitHub Actions` run type checks, linting and tests (`Jest`, `Vitest`) before every deploy to `Microsoft Azure` or a `Linux VPS` (`Docker`, `Nginx`), with `Turborepo` monorepos and `Grafana` **observability**.
domains.blurb: `GitHub Actions` run checks and tests before every deploy to **Azure** or a Linux VPS (`Docker`, `Nginx`).

domains.title: Applied AI & ML
domains.text: `Python` ML (`Pandas`, `NumPy`) exposed through REST APIs: automated KYC identity-document verification and a real-time text-autocompletion NLP model with 95% prediction accuracy. Daily agentic engineering with `Claude Code CLI` and `Gemini`.
domains.blurb: `Python` ML behind REST APIs: automated **KYC** document verification and a text-autocompletion NLP model.

featured.title: finance-tracker
featured.text: Personal finance PWA in `React 19` and **TypeScript**: multi-currency accounts at `NBP` rates, budgets, savings goals, a command palette and a one-click demo. **Firebase** sign-in, API on `Cloud Run`.

featured.title: finance-tracker-api
featured.text: REST API of the finance tracker: `Hono` with `Zod` schemas and **OpenAPI 3.1**, Firebase ID tokens, data in `Firestore` and `NBP` exchange rates with a cache. Tested on the Firestore emulator, runs on `Cloud Run`.

featured.title: movie-discovery
featured.text: Cinematic movie discovery on the `TMDB` API in Polish and English: trends, filters, where to watch in Poland, a watchlist with ratings and a pick for tonight. **TypeScript**, `Tailwind CSS`, e2e tests with **axe**.

featured.title: character-wiki-explorer
featured.text: Rick and Morty fan wiki built with `Astro` and `React` islands: about 1,000 static pages of characters, episodes and locations, instant search and a `WebGL` portal hero. **Deployed by GitHub Actions**.

featured.title: creative-agency-website
featured.text: Scroll-driven site of a fictional creative agency, **Nord Studio**: case studies, light and dark theme and smooth scrolling. `Astro`, `Tailwind CSS` and `GSAP`, **deployed by GitHub Actions**.

featured.title: gelato-brand-website
featured.text: Scroll-driven site of a gelato brand, **Velluto**: a cone built scoop by scoop, stacking menu cards and **WCAG 2.2 AA**. `Astro`, `Tailwind CSS` and `GSAP`, product renders made in `Blender`.

featured.title: portfolio-website-template
featured.text: Portfolio website template for developers: **one typed content file**, an accent colour from one number, light and dark theme, case-study pages and **WCAG 2.2 AA**. Built with `Astro` for `GitHub Pages`.

featured.title: personal-finance-manager
featured.text: Personal finance app: income and expenses by category, balance and spending charts, plus a one-click demo. **Firebase** sign-in (e-mail, Google), REST API on `Cloud Run` with `Firestore` and `Swagger` docs.
featured.blurb: Finance app with charts, a one-click demo and **Firebase** sign-in; API on `Cloud Run` with `Firestore`.

featured.title: personal-finance-manager-api
featured.text: REST API of the finance app: `Express` on `Cloud Run` verifies **Firebase** ID tokens and keeps each user's transactions in `Firestore`. `Joi` validation, `Swagger` docs, deployed by Actions with **no keys**.

featured.title: tmdb-movie-browser
featured.text: Movie browser on the `TMDb` API: search by title, trailers, watchlists and pagination, with data kept in local storage. Responsive layout built with `Parcel` and `SASS`, **deployed by GitHub Actions**.

featured.title: ieee754-conversion-simulator
featured.text: Console simulator of the decimal to 64-bit **IEEE 754** conversion, built from logic gates, a full adder, an `ALU` and a CPU model, with a hand-written parser, step-by-step output and **28** `xUnit` tests.

featured.title: cafe-management-system
featured.text: Console cafe system: a 16-product menu, orders with statuses, four payment methods, sorted history and sales statistics. An **OOP** showcase with `inheritance`, `interfaces`, `enums` and `generics`.

featured.title: id-verification
featured.text: Automated ID-document check: image pre-processing and **OCR** with `Tesseract`, a declared-country match, `OpenCV` Haar face detection and a `scikit-learn` SVM sign classifier. A base for KYC onboarding.

featured.title: next-word-prediction
featured.text: Next-word prediction: a bidirectional **LSTM** in `PyTorch`, trained on `NLTK`-preprocessed text corpora, suggests the word that follows 5 or 10 words. Includes tensor and `MNIST` warm-ups.

featured.title: food-brand-landing-page
featured.text: Mobile-first landing page of a food brand: product modals, a gallery and a `Swiper` reviews slider. **BEM** and `SASS`, built with `Parcel` and **deployed by GitHub Actions** to `GitHub Pages`.

featured.title: digital-agency-website
featured.text: Two-page agency site: offer, team, skills and a nine-project portfolio with a modal. **BEM** and `SASS`, responsive `@1x` to `@3x` images and a mobile menu, hosted on `GitHub Pages`.

featured.title: rikigo
featured.text: Marketplace for oversized cargo: customers set a price, carriers accept or bid, the platform settles payments. Core with a **state machine** and a **double-entry ledger** on `PostgreSQL`, in a `Turborepo` monorepo.
featured.blurb: Cargo marketplace: customers set a price, carriers accept or bid, the platform settles payments.

featured.title: pogotowieglazurnicze
featured.text: Site for a renovation firm: four service lines, a free-quote form and tap-to-call on every screen. **Lighthouse 100/100/100**, `WCAG 2.2 AA` tests, forms validated with `Zod`, built with `Next.js` and `Tailwind`.
featured.blurb: Renovation-firm site with a free-quote form and tap-to-call; **Lighthouse 100**, `WCAG 2.2 AA` tests.

featured.title: czarymaryokulary
featured.text: Redesigned site of an optical salon: offer, news and directions in a few clicks, light/dark mode. **Lighthouse 100** performance and SEO, **97** accessibility, built with `Next.js` and `Tailwind`.
featured.blurb: Optical-salon site with light/dark mode; **Lighthouse 100** performance and SEO, built with `Next.js`.

featured.title: damreboot
featured.text: Company platform: offer site, client portal with **CRM** and wallet, and this CV portfolio, as one `Turborepo` monorepo on a shared `MongoDB` layer. **Self-hosted** with `Docker` and `Caddy`.
featured.blurb: Offer site, client portal with **CRM** and this CV in one `Turborepo` monorepo, self-hosted.

featured.title: souler
featured.text: Portfolio of a fashion designer: collections as lookbooks and a rental box that sends one inquiry, with **i18n** routing. **No cookies, no tracking**, `WCAG 2.2 AA` tests, built with `Next.js` and `Playwright`.
featured.blurb: Fashion-designer portfolio: lookbooks and a rental inquiry box; **no cookies, no tracking**.

featured.title: karcar
featured.text: Site of a premium-car workshop: services, makes, social news pulled at build time and quote forms. A **static export** with a scroll-driven ECG line, `WCAG 2.2 AA` tests, built with `Next.js` and `Firebase`.
featured.blurb: Premium-car workshop site: services, makes and social news pulled at build time, **static export**.

featured.title: ui-components
featured.text: Library of unique and reusable `React` components with a live gallery: phone, tablet and desktop previews in light and dark, with the source and license of each.
